name: Autumn with the Shiba Inu
detailed_description:
Freelance hacker Quei-Li is given a new job: uncover information from the Allocated Reality Institute (ARI) about a high-profile corruption case. While she typically avoids high-risk jobs like this, her curiosity about the secret files and her wish to bring on positive change to Shiba Island convinces her to accept.

The job leads to Quei-Li bluffing her way into the ARI as an undercover programmer. She builds up a rapport with her coworkers while seeking the information her client needs. The more she digs around, the more secrets Quei-Li discovers, leading her to question her own existence.

Choose wisely - help Quei-Li navigate her undercover job. Will she succeed in retrieving the classified data?

Multiple endings - what seems like a good outcome might cause someone else to suffer. Your choices impact the endings!

Original character artwork - Alicia García Ochoa's dog illustrations make the inhabitants of Shiba Inu Island come to life.

Hacking mini-game - step into Quei-Li's role with a brain-twisting hacking mini-game! (The mini-game is completely optional)

Accessibility options - tune your experience and comfort while enjoying the game. Toggle between 4k resolution and full HD resolution.

Autumn with the Shiba Inu is set in the same universe as the first game in the Shiba Inu series, A Summer with the Shiba Inu. "Autumn" is a standalone story, so reading "Summer" is not required to enjoy Autumn with the Shiba Inu!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: 32/64-bit Windows 7 / 8.1 / 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz Intel or AMD Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL or DirectX Compatible Graphics Card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: 32/64-bit Windows 7 / 8.1 / 10
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1920 x 1080 display

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or later
  • Processor: Core 2 Duo or newer
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any OpenGL graphics card capable of running Mac OS X 10.6 or later
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.7 or later

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any distribution built for x86 or x64 processors
  • Processor: 1 GHz Intel or AMD Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL compatible graphics card

Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit processor
  • Processor: 1 GHz Intel or AMD Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL compatible graphics card
